title: Nimble Crumbly Turkish Butter Mini Dolma
description: A tangy, crumbly, comforting Turkish dish featuring butter, baked in individual mini cocottes, gluten-free friendly. Serve warm, garnished with fresh parsley or dill.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the ground lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and stir in the chopped parsley, chopped dill, lemon juice, and beaten egg.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Using a small spoon, fill each mini cocotte about 3/4 full of the lamb and rice mixture.
Mix the remaining 1 tablespoon butter with the gluten-free breadcrumbs and sprinkle over the filling.
Cover each cocotte with a small piece of parchment paper and cook in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Serve the dolmas warm, garnished with additional parsley or dill if desired.
